title: VLAff: Vision-Language-Affordance Model for Unified Actionable Affordances
description:
arXiv:2608.05215v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Learning manipulation skills from human videos is promising for scalable robot learning. However, the embodiment mismatch between humans and robots makes this challenging. One promising solution is to learn object-centric actionable affordances that are embodiment-agnostic.
